title: fix(cli): cancel interrupted skills status reports
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: `skills list`, `info` and `check` keep their Gateway read alive after an interrupt, then print misleading timeout diagnostics.

## User Impact

User impact: Ctrl-C/SIGTERM stops the pending report promptly, without a late report or timeout banner. Normal reports, missing-skill failures and authentication failures retain their outcomes.

## Why This Change Was Made

Forward the existing command signal only through the shared skills report reader, reject aborted reads before offline fallback, suppress canceled output, and preserve the interrupt exit in info. Install/update refresh, verification and mutation routing keep their existing owners.

Related ownership: #195342 changes the separate skills verification HTTP path; its implementation is not included here.

## Evidence

Product HEAD: `66ca45e8885a2d7a7d2b2bc498ee8f4720ceece8`; acceptance-red BASE: `eb1a592fc06233963cb8b70ad998f271b8e2da81`.

- **Actual entry:** clean normal QA builds run `node openclaw.mjs skills list --json`, `skills info proof-skill` and `skills check --json`. A transparent proxy forwards the real Gateway handshake/request and holds the successful actual skills.status reply before terminal Ctrl-C/SIGTERM is delivered. Actual PTY output, stderr and the exact held socket closure are recorded.
- **Same frozen red/green scenario:** All three BASE interruptions emit late timeout diagnostics; list exits from SIGTERM, while info/check exit143/130 after waiting for the RPC timeout. All three exact-HEAD interruptions naturally exit130/143 in **88.86–89.41ms**, close the correlated held socket in **5.05–9.65ms**, and emit only the normal interruption notice.
- **Legal controls and cleanup:** Five controls on both revisions: normal list JSON, human info and check JSON read the actual discovered workspace skill and exit0; missing skill and wrong-token authentication exit1. Configuration bytes stay unchanged, no watchdog fires, and no owned CLI/Gateway/proxy process survives cleanup. The isolated plugin/skill never sends a user message or calls a provider.
- **Checks:** BASE: two intended output regression failures,34 passing controls. HEAD:36 passing registered-command tests in 165.775s, including ordinary errors and existing install/update behavior. `pnpm test src/cli/skills-cli.commands.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`. Scoped types, typed lint and formatting pass; clean exact-HEAD QA build 291.139s. Independent GPT-6.1 Sol adversarial review: PASS, no findings.

Reproduce with the [unchanged collector](https://github.com/Alix-007/openclaw/blob/9c9f38a0ec458ae5b8c1275c17bf7871c3fb5307/skills-read-proof-v1.py): `python3 skills-read-proof-v1.py CHECKOUT FRESH_OUTPUT NODE26 EXPECTATION skills`. [Environment and observations](https://github.com/Alix-007/openclaw/blob/9c9f38a0ec458ae5b8c1275c17bf7871c3fb5307/EVIDENCE.md), [BASE receipt](https://github.com/Alix-007/openclaw/blob/9c9f38a0ec458ae5b8c1275c17bf7871c3fb5307/base-receipt.json), [HEAD receipt](https://github.com/Alix-007/openclaw/blob/9c9f38a0ec458ae5b8c1275c17bf7871c3fb5307/head-receipt.json), [actual terminal/RPC output](https://github.com/Alix-007/openclaw/blob/9c9f38a0ec458ae5b8c1275c17bf7871c3fb5307/head-streams.txt), [independent review](https://github.com/Alix-007/openclaw/blob/9c9f38a0ec458ae5b8c1275c17bf7871c3fb5307/independent-review.md).

Production +20/−4 lines; tests +14/−0 lines, 3 files. Existing-solutions preflight: reuse the existing command signal and Gateway abort owner; no new framework, dependency, configuration/default, public protocol/schema, permissions or migration. The complete bounded owner is covered as described above. Upstream CI is checked after publication.

Not tested: Skill execution, external ClawHub/Gateway services, install/update/verification cancellation, Windows/macOS and production load.
